mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that boosts equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate above 4% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher unemployment reduces consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth and housing market activity drives S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as a strong economy and housing market boost consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a decrease in supply chain activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate and inflation rate interact to drive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as high inflation and high interest rates reduce consumer spending and increase borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during strong labor market periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth, housing market activity, and consumer spending drives S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as a strong economy, housing market, and consumer spending boost equity markets.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 1% triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as low interest rates increase borrowing and spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.
